annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Digital Europe Programme 2021-2027 with a EUR 7.588 billion envelope.
Five specific objectives: HPC, AI, cybersecurity and trust, advanced digital skills, deployment and interoperability.
Article 5 requires ethical requirements in AI work programmes, with funding suspension for non-compliance.
AI solutions must respect privacy and security by design and comply with data protection law.
Security-based restrictions on participation by third-country-controlled entities; European Digital Innovation Hubs network.
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2021/694 establishes the Digital Europe Programme (2021-2027, EUR 7.588bn) funding HPC, AI, cybersecurity, advanced digital skills and digital deployment. AI funding carries ethical requirements and data-protection compliance. Robots, drones and self-driving cars appear only in recitals as examples of AI capacity.
